adapter.description: Adapter id that translates intent fields into this provider's request parameters (`scripts/adapters/<id>.mjs`).

allowed.description: Whether the domaiNN allows this Model. Declared in the domaiNN overlay; a model not allowed is refused before spend.

api_base.description: Base URL the provider's API is called at.

api_id.description: Exact model id the provider expects in a request.

asset.description: Source media file for a Layer (image or video), the directory of an authored HyperFrames project for an `animation` Layer, or the media of a fixed Scene Kind. One of `asset` or `prompt` is required for `avatar` and `media` Layers.

avatar.description: Image used as the source for an `avatar` Layer that declares no `asset::`. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Optional.

avatar_model.description: Avatar/lip-sync model id for an `avatar` Layer, or a cascade default (e.g. `wavespeed-ai/infinitetalk-fast`). Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. The console picklist offers the merged catalog's allowed avatar models by `api_id`.

avatar_resolution.description: Optional output resolution for an `avatar` clip. The engine validates it against the model's declared `controls` and falls back to a model-appropriate default. Ignored by other Layer types.

background.description: Background image of the active Character: a file name in its `backgrounds/` without extension. Defaults to the Character's `default_background`; requires an active `character`. Optional.

background_audio.description: Background audio file for the Scene. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Background audio is a Field and MUST NOT be modeled as a Layer.

background_audio_volume.description: Volume for the resolved `background_audio::` track (a number 0–1, e.g. `0.1`). Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade; when no level sets it the blueprint Video Defaults value applies.

budget.description: Per-episode budget in the domaiNN's single currency. The blueprint ships no default: an unset budget always asks at the budget gate. An estimate within the budget is auto-approved.

bumper.description: Series bumper media for this language, resolved as a logical name under `series/<s>/library/media/`.

capability.description: What the Model produces. Capability is declared, never inferred from the id.

caption_model.description: The transcript alignment model override. Defaults to the package model.

captions.description: Caption mode: `off` produces no captions, `words` word-level timing, `lines` segment-level timing. Defaults to `off`.

character.description: Name of the active Character (a folder in `library/characters/` or `media/characters/`). Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade; a series sets its host, a scene can bring a guest. Optional.

chrome.description: Chrome items applied to every scene of this kind. Each item resolves from the `Chrome` element for the cascaded `language`.

components.description: Keyed list of slot→component-name bindings (`slot=name`, e.g. `[lower-third=pill]`). Resolves per key through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Engine code names no component.

controls.description: Intent controls the Model declares. A non-default intent value for a control the Model does not declare fails at estimate, before any spend.

daily_budget.description: Rolling 24-hour cap in the domaiNN's single currency. Settable only in a Video Defaults document (domain or blueprint level); the blueprint ships no default (no daily cap).

delivered_version.description: The delivery version the engine last assembled (`v1`, `v2`, ...). Written by the engine together with `status:: delivered`.

description.description: What the episode is about, in one or two sentences. The agent writes it as part of the proposed changeset.

enter_animation.description: Enter motion of the Layer overlay. Optional.

exit_animation.description: Exit motion of the Layer overlay. Optional.

fit.description: How a `media` Layer fits its box. `cover` fills and crops; `contain` shows the whole asset with margins. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade; when no level sets it the blueprint Video Defaults value applies.

fixed.description: Placement of an engine-inserted scene: `none`, `first`, `last` or `after:<kind>` (after the first scene of that kind). The episode does not declare fixed scenes; the engine inserts them with the kind's `asset`.

frame.description: Name of the frame folder (`library/frames/<name>/FRAME.md` at the episode, series, domain or package level) whose tokens style this Video, Scene, Series or domain. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade; when no level sets it the blueprint Video Defaults value applies.

image_model.description: Provider model id used to synthesize image assets (e.g. `wavespeed-ai/z-image/turbo`). Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. The console picklist offers the merged catalog's allowed image models by `api_id`.

image_size.description: Requested image size as `<W>x<H>`, validated against the resolved image Model's `sizes`. Part of the image cache key. Defaults to `1024x1024` in the blueprint Video Defaults.

intro.description: Intro media reused by the episode's fixed first Scene. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Optional; per episode, so not a Scene field.

kind.description: Name of a Scene Kind declared by the Series, or the reserved value `Libre`. Required on every V_0-15-0 Scene; the engine validates it against the Series and offers no static options. A `Libre` scene takes no kind rules, presets or chrome, so it renders with no watermark, CTA, bumper or music.

language.description: Language code (for example `es`, `en`) driving voice selection, chrome text, narration rules and the description language. The blueprint ships no default: an unset language is a validation error.

master.description: The episode's master `<slug>_<W>x<H>.mp4`, sized by the first entry of `output_formats`. Delivery formats are derived from it and never modeled.

max_duration.description: Maximum duration of a scene of this kind, in seconds. Compared with the estimate before spend and with the measured duration after TTS; an overrun is a warning, never a stop.

music.description: Series music bed for this language, resolved as a logical name under `series/<s>/library/media/`. Retired on Scene and Preset, where `background_audio` is the only field.

narration.description: Whether scenes of this kind carry narration. With `on`, the measured narration sets the scene length and every `animation` Layer is trimmed or looped to it. `off` means no TTS request is made, a non-empty scene body is an error, and the scene takes its length from its media or animation.

output_formats.description: Ordered list of delivery sizes as `<W>x<H>`. The first entry is the master size; the rest are derived from the master. Defaults to `[1920x1920, 1080x1920, 1920x1080, 1080x1080]`.

placement.description: For a `media` Layer: `full` covers the frame, `inset` places it inside the safe area. Required on `media`.

pose.description: Avatar pose of the active Character: a file name in its `avatars/` without extension. Defaults to the Character's `default_pose`; requires an active `character`. Optional.

position.description: Overlay anchor inside the central safe square (the central 1080x1080 of the master).

presets.description: Ordered list of Preset names that apply at this level, written as bare names such as `[Lucas, Studio Warm]` (no reference brackets). Each level's list sits directly under that level's explicit fields: the last Preset of a list wins, a level's explicit fields beat its own Presets, and lists are additive across levels. Optional.

price.description: Unit price in the domaiNN's single currency, in the unit named by `price_unit`. Absent or unset blocks the run for an allowed model.

price_date.description: Date the price was observed (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Older than `stale_after_days` warns and never blocks.

price_source.description: Where the price came from. The domaiNN overlay sets `invoice` when it overrides the reference price.

prompt.description: Media-synthesis prompt used when a Layer has no asset. One of `asset` or `prompt` is required for `avatar` and `media` Layers.

provider.description: Slug of the `Provider` element this Model belongs to.

review.description: The reviewer's verdict on the scene. Every scene must be `approved` before the episode can reach `approved`; a reason is a changeset comment, never a field.

review_gates.description: The gates that stop the run before spend, in order. Defaults to `[script, preview]`. Replaces the retired single script-review flag.

role.description: Free-text role of the kind in the series format (for example `hook`, `news`, `wrap-up`). Orientative for the author, never enforced as an order.

script.description: The episode's script document, resolved under the owning model's directory.

sizes.description: Image sizes the Model accepts, as `<W>x<H>` entries. `image_size` must be one of them.

sounds.description: Keyed list of engine-event→sound-name bindings (`event=name`, e.g. `[scene-boundary=whoosh]`). Resolves per key through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Engine code names no sound.

stale_after_days.description: Days after `price_date` at which the price is considered stale. Defaults to 90.

status.description: Lifecycle position of the episode, written by the engine or the user through a changeset. `idea` carries a title and linked Sources only.

style.description: For a `text` Layer: the visual component to render. The component implementation resolves by name (`components/<style>`, a folder `library/components/<style>/` or `media/components/<style>/`, episode → series → domain → skill fallback), so a Series can restyle it without a new type.

tags.description: Open vocabulary ad-hoc tags and classification labels.

text.description: Inline text for a `text` Layer. One of `text` or `source` is required.

text_from.description: For a `text` Layer: the reserved value `narration` renders the owning Scene's body prose. Mutually exclusive with `text`.

thumbnail.description: The episode's cover image, resolved under the owning model's directory.

thumbnail_badge.description: An optional small badge drawn on the thumbnail; defaults to none.

thumbnail_base.description: A text-free clean composite used as the thumbnail base; defaults to the first scene still.

thumbnail_formats.description: Ordered thumbnail sizes as `<W>x<H>`. Defaults to `[2560x1440, 1080x1920]`.

thumbnail_title.description: The title text drawn on the thumbnail; defaults to the Video `title`.

timing.description: For a `media` Layer: `scene` spans the whole scene, `slot` occupies an overlay slot. Required on `media`.

title.description: Human title of the Video or the Series. The engine derives the manifest compositionId from the Video's title.

transition.description: Transition into the Scene. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Optional.

translation_of.description: For a translation episode, the slug of the original (`<slug>` in the same series, or `<series>/<slug>` across series). The original MUST exist, MUST NOT itself be a translation and MUST share the source; never points at itself. Video-only record field.

type.description: Required Layer behaviour type. `avatar` is a lip-synced paid job; `media` is an image or a video; `text` is overlay text; `animation` mounts an authored HyperFrames project as a sub-composition. Appearance and visual components come from Presets, never from the type.

voice.description: Registered voice name or system voice used for TTS synthesis. Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade; a Preset supplies it unless a nearer level sets it. Part of the synthesized-audio cache identity. The console picklist offers the merged catalog's Voices by slug.

voice_emotion.description: Delivery the provider synthesizes the narration with (e.g. `happy`, `neutral`). Optional; when no level declares it the provider default applies and the value stays out of the cache key. Part of the synthesized-audio cache identity, so changing it re-synthesizes.

voice_id.description: The provider's own voice identifier, used verbatim in a TTS request.

voice_model.description: Provider model id used for TTS synthesis (e.g. `minimax/speech-2.8-hd`). Resolves through the Universal Parameter Cascade. Part of the synthesized-audio cache identity. The console picklist offers the merged catalog's allowed tts models by `api_id`.

voice_speed.description: Playback rate the provider synthesizes the narration at (a number, e.g. `1.1` for 10% faster). Optional; when no level declares it the provider default applies and the value stays out of the cache key. Part of the synthesized-audio cache identity, so changing it re-synthesizes.

watermark.description: Watermark text for this language, for example an AI-disclosure line.

z_index.description: Paint order of the Layer as a numeric string (higher renders on top). Optional.
